verdicts.title: Classification of quadratic APN functions with coefficients in F2 for dimensions up to 9
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Abstract Almost perfect nonlinear (APN) and almost bent (AB) functions are integral components of modern block ciphers and play a fundamental role in symmetric cryptography. In this paper, we describe a procedure for searching for quadratic APN functions with coefficients in F 2 over the finite field F 2 n and apply this procedure to classify all such functions over F 2 n with n ≤ 9 .
